semina.translation:
精液, 种子

seminal.definition: a. pertaining to or containing or consisting of semen
seminal.translation:
a. 精液的, 种子的, 生殖的

seminal cyst.translation: [医] 精液囊肿(附睾或精索)

seminal ducts.translation: [医] 精管(包括输精管、精囊管、射精管)

seminality.definition: n. The quality or state of being seminal.

seminar.definition:

n. 研究班, 专题讨论会

seminarians.definition:
plural of seminarian
n. a student at a seminary (especially a Roman Catholic seminary)

seminaries.translation: n. 神学院( seminary的名词复数 ); 中等学校; 神学院学生

seminarist.definition: n a student at a seminary (especially a Roman Catholic seminary)

seminarists.definition:
plural of seminarist
n a student at a seminary (especially a Roman Catholic seminary)

seminars.definition:
n. any meeting for an exchange of ideas
n. a course offered for a small group of advanced students
seminars.translation: n. 研讨班( seminar的复数形式 ); 研讨小组; 研讨会; 培训会

seminary.definition:
n. a private place of education for the young
n. a theological school for training ministers or priests or rabbis
seminary.translation: n. 神学院, 发源地

seminate.definition: v. t. To sow; to spread; to propagate.

seminated.translation: vt. 散布, 传播；播种于

seminating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Seminate
seminating.translation: vt. 散布, 传播；播种于

semination.definition:
n. The act of sowing or spreading.
n. Natural dispersion of seeds.
semination.translation:
n. 播种, 传播
[医] 授精

seminiferous.definition: a. bearing or producing seed or semen
seminiferous.translation: a. 产种子的, 产生精液的, 输精的

seminist.definition:
n. A believer in the old theory that the newly created being
   is formed by the admixture of the seed of the male with the supposed
   seed of the female.

seminole.definition:
n. a member of the Muskhogean people who moved into Florida in the 18th century
n. the Muskhogean language of the Seminole
seminole.translation: n. 塞米诺族人；塞米诺语

seminoles.definition:
n. pl. A tribe of Indians who formerly occupied Florida,
   where some of them still remain. They belonged to the Creek
   Confideration.

seminoma.definition: n malignant tumor of the testis; usually occurring in older men

seminose.definition:
n. A carbohydrate of the glucose group found in the
   thickened endosperm of certain seeds, and extracted as yellow sirup
   having a sweetish-bitter taste.
